IRS990.Desc: TO DELIVER ON ITS MISSION, AVID (ADVANCEMENT VIA INDIVIDUAL DETERMINATION) HAS DEVELOPED A PROGRAMMATIC MODEL THAT 7,400 SCHOOLS IN 46 STATES AND THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA ARE IMPLEMENTING ALONG WITH SCHOOLS IN THE U.S. VIRGIN ISLANDS, CANADA, AND AUSTRALIA AND WITH DODEA. WE PROVIDE DIRECT ONGOING SUPPORT TO ALL IMPLEMENTING SCHOOLS AND DISTRICTS. WE ALSO DELIVER THREE-DAY FACE-TO-FACE TRAININGS FOR EDUCATORS IN VARIOUS ROLES TO GUIDE THEM IN IMPLEMENTING AND SUSTAINING AVID, HONING THEIR PRACTICES, AND IMPROVING THEIR SYSTEMS. WE HOLD THESE TRAININGS ACROSS THE COUNTRY IN THE SUMMER.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: AVID ALSO CONDUCTS TWO-DAY FACE-TO-FACE TRAININGS LOCALLY OR REGIONALLY AS WELL AS TWO-DAY VIRTUAL TRAININGS FOR EDUCATORS IN VARIOUS ROLES TO IMPLEMENT AND SUSTAIN AVID, HONE THEIR PRACTICES, AND IMPROVE THEIR SYSTEMS. THESE TWO-DAY TRAININGS ARE HELD DURING THE SCHOOL YEAR AND IN THE SUMMER.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: AVID PROVIDES YEAR-LONG, MULTI-SESSION TRAININGS DISTRICT DIRECTORS WHO OVERSEE THE AVID IMPLEMENTATION IN THEIR DISTRICT. THE TRAININGS ARE DESIGNED TO EQUIP THE DISTRICT DIRECTORS TO LEAD AND SUSTAIN THE AVID IMPLEMENTATIONS IN THEIR DISTRICT.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: AVID CENTER RETAINS LOBBYISTS TO PROMOTE AWARENESS OF THE EFFECTIVENESS OF THE AVID ELECTIVE AND ITS IMPORTANCE FOR THE ADVANCEMENT OF EDUCATION FOR CHILDREN IN PUBLIC SECONDARY SCHOOLS. IN THE CURRENT ERA OF DECLINING REVENUE FOR PUBLIC EDUCATION IN MANY STATES, LOBBYING IS ESSENTIAL TO ENSURE AVID STAYS AN AUTHORIZED VENDOR IN THE SCHOOL SYSTEMS, CONTINUE STATE FUNDING FOR AVID OR MINIMIZE THE IMPACT OF CUTS WHEN REQUIRED. THE LOBBYING ACTIVITY PRIMARILY CONSISTS OF SELECTED MEETINGS WITH VARIOUS OFFICIALS AND AGENCIES BY AVID EXECUTIVE DIRECTORS AND SENIOR LEADERS AND OUR LOBBYING AND PUBLIC AFFAIRS CONSULTANTS TO EXPLAIN THE IMPACT OF AVID. THESE EFFORTS ARE INTENDED TO ENSURE AVID REMAINS AN APPROVED PROVIDER AND OUR ELECTIVE COURSE IS AN APPROVED COURSE AS WELL AS TO MAINTAIN OR SECURE PROGRAM FUNDING THAT LOCAL SCHOOL DISTRICTS AND COUNTY BOARDS OF EDUCATION CAN USE FOR AVID.

THE ORGANIZATION FOLLOWS THE PROVISIONS OF UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS AS ADDRESSED IN FINANCIAL ACCOUNTING STANDARDS BOARD ACCOUNTING STANDARDS CODIFICATION. THE ORGANIZATION RECOGNIZES ACCRUED INTEREST AND PENALTIES ASSOCIATED WITH UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS AS PART OF THE INCOME TAX PROVISION, WHEN APPLICABLE. THERE ARE NO AMOUNTS ACCRUED IN THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS RELATED TO UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS FOR THE YEARS ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024 AND 2023.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: COLLEGE SCHOLARSHIPS ARE ADMINISTERED BY THE SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION: FUNDING FOR SCHOLARSHIPS IS SENT DIRECTLY TO THE FINANCIAL AID OFFICE OF THE UNIVERSITY WHICH THE STUDENT PLANS TO ATTEND. AVID ASKS FOR THE FOLLOWING IN ORDER TO SEND PAYMENT TO THE UNIVERSITY: 1. END OF YEAR TRANSCRIPT FROM THEIR HIGH SCHOOL. 2. UNIVERSITY ACCEPTANCE LETTER AND PROOF OF ENROLLMENT. 3. ALUMNI SURVEY FOR STUDENTS SUCH AS THE FOUNDER'S SCHOLARSHIP RECIPIENT, THAT MUST BE SUBMITTED ANNUALLY. TEACHERS SCHOLARSHIPS: THE TEACHERS FROM CALIFORNIA SUBMIT AN APPLICATION FOR THE SCHOLARSHIP. THERE IS A TEAM OF PEOPLE THAT REVIEW THE APPLICATIONS AND DECIDE ON THE WINNERS. THE FUNDING IS GIVEN DIRECTLY TO THE TEACHERS. THERE IS NO FOLLOW UP.

AS A PRACTICE, NONE OF THE ABOVE ARE PROVIDED TO AN OFFICER, DIRECTOR, TRUSTEE, KEY EMPLOYEE OR HIGHEST COMPENSATED EMPLOYEE. AVID CENTER POLICY IS TO USE ECONOMY CLASS AIRFARE BOOKED NO LESS THAN FOURTEEN BUSINESS DAYS IN ADVANCE AND NO MORE THAN NINETY DAYS IN ADVANCE OF TRAVEL. ON RARE OCCASIONS FIRST CLASS TICKETS HAVE BEEN PURCHASED WHEN LOWER FARES HAVE BEEN UNAVAILABLE AND BUSINESS NEEDS DICTATE THE TRIP. AN EXCEPTION MAY ALSO BE MADE FOR HEALTH-RELATED ISSUES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: FORM 990 IS REVIEWED IN FINAL DRAFT FORM BY THE CEO, CBO, CFO AND THE CONTROLLER ALONG WITH THE AUDIT COMMITTEE. ONCE THE 990 IS APPROVED BY THE AUDIT COMMITTEE, COPIES ARE DISTRIBUTED TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS. THE AUDIT COMMITTEE THEN RECOMMENDS THE BOARD TO APPROVE THE 990 PRIOR TO FILING THE RETURN WITH THE IRS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ANNUALLY THE BOARD SIGNS A COPY OF THE CONFLICT-OF-INTEREST POLICY. BOARD MEMBERS ARE REQUIRED TO NOTIFY AVID CENTER OF ANY PROPOSED OR ONGOING TRANSACTIONS THAT COULD GIVE RISE TO A CONFLICT OF INTEREST BY WRITING TO THE CEO OR BOARD CHAIR. IN ADDITION, THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY REQUIRES ALL EMPLOYEES TO DISCLOSE POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST; THIS WOULD EXTEND TO AND INCLUDE OFFICERS, KEY EMPLOYEES, AND HIGHLY COMPENSATED EMPLOYEES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: BOARD POLICY AND THE CEO'S CONTRACT BOTH REQUIRE AN INDEPENDENT SALARY SURVEY. THE CEO IN TURN COMMISSIONS INDEPENDENT SALARY STUDY FOR SENIOR LEADERS. RESULTS ARE PRESENTED TO THE CEO WHO REVIEWS AND APPROVES ANY ADJUSTMENTS FOR SENIOR LEADERSHIP POSITIONS AND THE BOARD APPROVES THE CEO'S COMPENSATION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 18
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE PUBLIC INSPECTION COPY OF THE ORGANIZATION'S FORM 990, FROM THE PREVIOUS THREE YEARS, WILL BE AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST VIA EMAIL TO THE CEO, CBO, CFO OR CONTROLLER.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATIONAL DOCUMENTS WILL BE AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST VIA EMAIL TO THE CEO, CBO, CFO OR CONTROLLER. THE ORGANIZATION SHALL FULFILL SUCH REQUEST IN A TIMELY FASHION WITHOUT INQUIRING AS TO THE REASON FOR PUBLIC INSPECTION REQUEST.
